ticket.subject: Charged twice this month
ticket.body: I was charged twice for order A-104 on the same day. Please refund the duplicate. I cannot place another order until this is sorted.

refund_requested.instructions: Does the customer ask for a refund?

criteria.true: The customer asks for money back, a refund, or a charge to be reversed.
criteria.false: The customer reports a problem without asking for money back.

blocked.instructions: Does the customer say they cannot carry on using the product?

criteria.true: The customer states they are unable to do something they need to do.
criteria.false: The customer can still use the product, even if something is inconvenient.

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, refunds and payment methods
criteria.technical: Something in the product is broken or behaving wrongly
criteria.other: Anything the other options do not cover

criteria: Nothing is blocked and it can wait until next week
Something is inconvenient and should be handled today
The customer cannot carry on until somebody acts
